title: Don't Stop Believin': Everyman's Journey

text.lead: Don't Stop Believin': Everyman's Journey is a 2012 American documentary film of the band Journey and its new lead vocalist Arnel Pineda.
text.cast:
- Neal Schon - Lead Guitar, Vocals
- Ross Valory - Bass, Vocals
- Jonathan Cain - Keyboards, Rhythm Guitar, Vocals
- Deen Castronovo - Drums, Percussion, Vocals
- Arnel Pineda - Lead Vocals
- Katherine Heigl as herself
text.reception: Don't Stop Believin': Everyman's Journey received mixed to positive reviews, holding a 62% "fresh" rating on Rotten Tomatoes; the consensus states: "An energetic but thin portrait of the venerable rock band Journey, Don't Stop Believin ' gets a boost from new singer Arnel Pineda's charming personality." It has a 53/100 rating on Metacritic, signifying "mixed or average" reviews. The film opened the 2013–2014 season of PBS's Independent Lens, where it won the Audience Award.

sections.Lead: Don't Stop Believin': Everyman's Journey is a 2012 American documentary film of the band Journey and its new lead vocalist Arnel Pineda.
sections.Overview: The film shows the band during the Revelation Tour in the United States and Pineda's homecoming in Manila, Philippines where they performed in front of 25,000 people.
